SAVE (Safe Alternatives to Violent Environments) is dedicated to empowering survivors of domestic violence with the resources, advocacy, and support they need to rebuild safe, stable lives. We operate with a survivor-centered, trauma-informed approach — and we're looking for a passionate Housing Case Manager to join our team.

The Housing Case Manager (HCM) plays a critical role in SAVE's Housing First Services program, helping survivors of domestic violence achieve housing stability and long-term independence. You'll provide intensive case management, connect clients to financial assistance and community resources, and advocate on their behalf with landlords, government agencies, and community-based organizations.

This role operates across two housing programs with distinct funding sources and requirements, offering a dynamic and meaningful caseload of 12–18 clients at varying levels of need. This is a full-time hourly role that is eligible for overtime.

Position Summary

The College of Health and Human Services (CHHS) is seeking an Administrative Support Coordinator II to provide centralized coordination and administrative support for graduate programs across the College, including its Joint Doctoral Programs (JDPs). The Coordinator supports graduate programs throughout the student lifecycle—from recruitment and admissions through enrollment, academic progress, degree completion, and alumni follow-up. The position also provides dedicated administrative coordination for the Joint Doctoral Program in Interdisciplinary Research in Substance Use, including collaboration with UC San Diego, and contributes to Dean’s Office communications, events, and operations. This role is well suited for someone who excels at managing multiple priorities, navigating detailed administrative processes, building collaborative relationships, and ensuring important work is completed accurately and on time.

Graduate Program Coordination: Coordinate administrative processes, timelines, records, and communications across CHHS graduate and Joint Doctoral Programs, ensuring required activities are completed accurately and on schedule.
Student Lifecycle Administration: Support processes spanning recruitment and admissions, enrollment, academic progress, degree completion, and alumni follow-up while maintaining organized records and tracking required actions.
Joint Doctoral Program Support: Provide dedicated administrative coordination for the Joint Doctoral Program in Interdisciplinary Research in Substance Use, including collaboration with UC San Diego and support for examinations, course agreements, documentation, and student processes.

Communication & Stakeholder Support: Serve as a central administrative resource for program directors, faculty, students, alumni, staff, College leadership, and external partners by communicating established processes, coordinating follow-up, and connecting stakeholders with appropriate resources.
Administrative Problem Solving: Monitor deadlines and workflow, identify and resolve routine administrative issues, and coordinate with the Associate Dean or appropriate campus offices when matters require additional policy or program expertise.
Dean’s Office Operations: Support College communications and email management, special events, front-office functions, and other administrative projects that contribute to the academic and research operations of CHHS.

We’re not only the largest Mexican-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we’re also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands.

From ensuring we use high quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that hasn’t been done before… we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries.

We’re a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we’re at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más.

At Taco Bell, we’re Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.

About The Job

The Program Manager, Value & Digital Enterprise is a strategic leadership role within Taco Bell’s Enterprise Operations & Program Management team. This role leads the integrated Value, Digital Integration, and Loyalty portfolios, translating business strategy into coordinated cross-functional plans that deliver current-year commitments while building the future pipeline.

The Program Manager provides senior program leadership across multiple interconnected portfolios, leading through ambiguity, aligning priorities across functions, surfacing risks and trade-offs early, and ensuring leaders have the visibility and recommendations required to make timely decisions. The role partners closely with category and enterprise Team Leads and works across Marketing, Digital & Technology, Product, FIT, Operations, Finance, Insights, and other cross-functional teams to connect strategy, planning, and execution through Taco Bell’s 3Ds Enterprise System.

This role also leads and develops two L8 Associate Program Managers, allocating program-management capacity based on business complexity, risk, and priority while building a high-performing program-management capability. Success requires a leader who can operate at both Speed 1, delivering today’s commitments, and Speed 2, planning and enabling tomorrow’s growth.

The Day-to-Day

Value Portfolio Leadership

Partner with the Value Team Lead to translate Value strategy into an integrated current- and future-year roadmap across testing, national launches, and pipeline development.
Lead program management across the Value portfolio, connecting initiatives through Discover, Design, and Deploy and ensuring cross-functional readiness for key business milestones.
Identify sequencing, resource, timing, and cross-functional dependencies early; develop scenarios and recommended paths when priorities, scope, or capacity conflict.
Provide leadership visibility into portfolio health, critical milestones, decisions, risks, and readiness, ensuring issues are surfaced at the right time and level.

Digital Integration & Loyalty Leadership

Lead integrated planning across Digital Integration and Loyalty, connecting initiatives to the broader Marketing calendar, enterprise priorities, and enabling technology and operational roadmaps.
Align business objectives and cross-functional roadmaps across Marketing, Digital & Technology, Operations, FIT, Finance, Product, and other partners to ensure coordinated delivery.
Anticipate enterprise dependencies and readiness risks that could impact customer experience, launch timing, or business outcomes and establish mitigation plans before issues become execution barriers.
Create clear governance and leadership visibility for complex initiatives requiring sustained cross-functional coordination and decision support.

The Sr. Data Analyst will focus on measuring AI visibility, evaluating AI-generated answers, and understanding how changes in content and AI search systems affect client outcomes. The work combines analytics, data science, research, experimentation, and LLM evaluation.

This position will build and maintain the measurement systems behind tracked prompts, analyze changes across engines, topics, and markets, and connect AI visibility with measurable business outcomes such as referral traffic, engagement, bookings, and conversions. The role is remote in the United States, aligned to ET/CT, with occasional travel to NYC or Atlanta.

•Track how often, how favorably, and how accurately clients appear in AI answers compared with defined competitive sets, using rigorous baselines, sampling, and stated uncertainty.

•Identify the sources cited by AI systems for specific topics and characterize the source mix.
•Track when published content begins appearing as cited evidence, how long it takes to surface, and how long citations remain active.
•Identify gaps in clients' evidence bases and determine what information or content is missing.
•Test how source, framing, format, specificity, recency, and structure affect whether content is selected by AI systems.
•Connect AI visibility with referral traffic, engagement, bookings, and conversions, while documenting what can and cannot currently be measured.
•Evaluate AI answers for accuracy, relevance, and completeness.
•Catalog AI answer failure modes by engine over time and maintain evaluation rubrics, benchmarks, and rater-agreement processes.
•Continuously refine prompt construction and apply the same evaluation discipline to internally developed AI features.
•Research how AI search systems retrieve and cite sources and validate claims through research rather than industry commentary.
•Work with product and engineering teams to define product metrics.

•Hands-on fluency with LLMs and agentic tooling, including prompt design, evaluation harnesses, and agents that collect and process data at volume.

•Experience designing experiments with observational data, including comparison group construction, difference-in-differences or matched comparisons, and appropriate consideration of statistical power.

•Startup experience, including work in fast-moving, small teams with a high level of visibility and ownership.

The compensation range is $120,000–$140,000, plus equity and an annual bonus. Benefits include a 401(k) with a 4% match, monthly wellness stipend, comprehensive medical and dental insurance plans, long-term disability, and more.

About the Company

Founded in 2008, ClearOne Advantage helps clients resolve large credit card bills and other unsecured debts without the need for personal bankruptcy. Headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, the company has more than 500 employees working fully remotely and operates in the direct-to-consumer financial services industry. ClearOne Advantage is committed to treating people with respect and empathy.

About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst will bring strong data discipline and analytical rigor to how ClearOne measures, optimizes, and improves the client journey, from first contact through settlements. This role supports teams across the business and uses data to measure performance, identify opportunities, and guide better decisions.

The position is not limited to one department. The Senior Data Analyst will work across areas including Marketing & Sales, Client Services, Finance, Revenue Operations, and Affiliates, providing sharper measurement and faster answers where needed. The role involves independently setting the analytical agenda, designing reporting systems, surfacing issues proactively, and partnering with business leadership, Data Engineering, and the broader Analytics organization.

Key Responsibilities

•Independently design and build reporting systems for multi-domain business questions, including financial performance, borrowing base, and client journey analysis.
•Deliver recurring, high-visibility reporting such as daily performance summaries, weekly trend reports, and executive-facing briefings for business leadership.
•Turn loosely defined questions into clear analytical frameworks and partner with stakeholders to define success and build appropriate reporting and analysis.
•Partner with Data Engineering to identify, escalate, and improve data quality within Snowflake.
•Adopt and promote AI-assisted analytical tools and workflows, including LLMs and Copilot, and share effective approaches with teammates.
•Collaborate across teams as analytical questions span multiple business functions and data domains.
•Proactively identify issues and opportunities where stronger measurement or analysis can support business decisions.

Required Qualifications

•2–3 years of experience in an analytics or business intelligence role, with demonstrated progression toward senior-level ownership of reporting systems and analytical agendas.
•Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as Analytics or Information Systems, or in a business field.
•Strong SQL skills, with Snowflake preferred.
•Fluency in complex aggregations, cohort analysis, time-series comparisons, and data quality debugging.
•Proficiency in Tableau, including the ability to build and maintain production dashboards for operational and executive audiences.
•Proven ability to turn ambiguous business questions into rigorous analytical frameworks and defensible recommendations.
•Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings clearly to non-technical leaders and constructively challenge ill-formed requests.
•Experience partnering with Data Engineering on pipeline, modeling, and data quality issues.
•Comfort using AI-assisted analytical tools such as LLMs and Copilot.
•Willingness to share effective AI-assisted analytical approaches and best practices with the broader team.

Preferred Qualifications / Requirements

•Experience working with Snowflake is preferred.
•Experience supporting analytical questions across multiple business domains is relevant to the role.

Salary & Benefits

ClearOne Advantage operates as a fully remote workplace. Benefits include generous PTO and paid holidays, along with a full suite of benefits covering 401(k), health, dental, vision, life, disability, and HSA.
